blocks.text: The Wyze Bulb cam is a smart home camera designed for outdoor use, intended to replace regular bulbs in porch downlights and wall lights. This camera can monitor the entire front or back yard and porch while also providing improved ambient illumination. The product features a standard E26 socket, allowing for easy installation without the need for tools or special skills.

items: Smart Lighting and Wide 160° View Security Camera - A motion-activated light and security camera are conveniently powered by any light fixture for effortless outdoor protection and automation. Sees more with a 160° wide-view bulb camera for enhanced protection.

Telescoping Internal Rod and Manual Adjustable Pan &Tilt, Easy Bluetooth Setup - Extend the camera up to 1.2inch, pan 360° and tilt up to 90° to find just the right angle. This light bulb camera applicable to E26 socket ( 120v 60hz input) and enables Bluetooth setup (No need to scan QR codes.) and works with Alexa/Google Assistant/IFTTT and Wyze Rules for smart home automation.

Clear 2K HD Resolution with WDR and Color Night Vision - Protect double the area in greater detail with high-definition clarity. WDR evens out darker and lighter spots in the same scene for a more even picture.
Dimmable 800 Lumen LED Bulb - Customize the brightness on these long-lasting LED bulbs to achieve the perfect lighting.
24/7 Local Recording with MicroSD Card* - Don’t miss a thing with continuous local recording to a microSD card up to 256 GB. No subscription required. (*MicroSD cards sold separately. )
Two-Way Audio & Free detection alerts - Speak to people and pets from anywhere right from your smartphone. Get notified on your smartphone when motion and sound are detected.

AI Notifications and Descriptive Alerts – With Cam Unlimited Pro (subscription required), customize detection and alerts for People, Pets, Packages, and Vehicles, and receive detailed descriptions of detected events.

Group Light Control with Wyze Accessory Bulbs – Expand your smart lighting by pairing up to 5 accessory bulbs for full coverage (Accessory Bulb sold separately). NOTE: The Bulb Cam already features a built-in LED light. Accessory Bulbs are designed to extend lighting coverage or replace existing bulbsfor "Group Light Control", and are only compatible with the Wyze Bulb Cam.
